scope: Difficulty 0: 8 professions × 4 paired seeds = 64 runs; difficulty 3: 8 professions × 2 paired seeds = 32 runs; 96 full runs total.
method: Two-action greedy legal battle lookahead; paired deterministic seed strings beta19-${profession}-${index}-d${difficulty}; actual route rooms; rewards claimed using defaults; camp heal at HP <=24; shop once per act when affordable and not urgent for camp; evidence-supported acquisitions prefer nonduplicates. CandidateFit v19 is used consistently for v19 and v20. Pressure counts count distinct battle turns with enemyPressure >0 and distinct turns showing an intent with shieldAfter. Signature counters record hot_iron armor-pierce plays where forge reaches the threshold, successful mail_return discounts on recovered cards, and successful active-heal medic_badge trigger turns (not item/full-health nontriggers). JSON roundtrip after every action; public wrapper used for actions and checked against direct v19/v20 dispatch.
limitations: Small deterministic policy sample, not human-play balance evidence. CandidateFit evidence is a heuristic; the policy does not optimize long-term deck value, relic/item purchases, shop services, event pacts, or route choices. Runs stop at a 600-action bound.
